image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, earthy surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. The front left limb is clearly visible with distinct digits, while the rear limbs are partially obscured by the body's curvature. The tail curves around the body, showing the characteristic black and yellow pattern.
